_source: 2026 S95H OLED (QN83S95HAEXZA, wireless): tester report 0.4.0 with driver 2.4.11, firmware 2.5.3.123, SmartThings on, Power On with Mobile and IP Remote on, sent by the owner 2026-11-17. restStoppedS and restStandbyS from the first report's test 8 readings (no REST answer from the first reading at 5 s through 52 s, PowerState standby from 57 s); the first reading was already silent, so REST may stop sooner. restAfterOffS 72 is the last reading, not a measured end. REST still answered PowerState standby when test 10 started, so it stays up in standby; bootS from test 10's restOnMs (20.8 s, 3 Wake-on-LAN sends; firstAnswerMs 10.2 s was a standby answer). Not modelled: REST before 5 s after off; whether KEY_POWER over the standby socket wakes it (the mock ignores keys in standby). Second report (tester 0.5.0, same day): REST answered PowerState standby at every reading from 5 s to 72 s with no gap, so the gap is not every time; connectMs 157, launchMs 320.
